common.raw_artifacts: private on Powerboat: kit frames, audio and video in ~/fes-scratch/c64acc/runs/<run>/fr, driver event logs in runs/<run>/result.json, VICE frames (.png and raw VIC colour-index .idx), audio and event logs in ~/fes-scratch/c64acc/vref/<ref>; only hashes are committed
common.audio_activity_method: tools/aud.py: mono mix, DC removed, RMS per 1 s window, a window is active above -50 dBFS; no tolerance was declared in advance, so activity counts are presence evidence, not a pass criterion
common.input_scripts: inputs/kit-<run>.jsonl are the exact kit scripts (kik1 used the kik2 script); inputs/vice-*.jsonl are the VICE scripts. tools/ holds the driver and helpers; wander timing is wall-clock (seeded move sequence, random 0.15-0.7 s holds), so play is reproducible in sequence, not in time

library_media_incident.what: early VICE reference runs attached library D64s read-write; Lode Runner wrote its high-score sector 12/7 and MW4 wrote its config byte (file 00, 17/0)
library_media_incident.method: the writes were inverted (three high-score records zeroed; fastloader byte 1->0) and checked against the 64-bit SHA-256 prefixes recorded before any run; file mtimes now differ from the originals; all kit runs used read-only copies of the restored bytes

vice_runs.note: frames are raw VIC colour-index buffers (.idx); kit frames are 1920x1080 HDMI captures, so kit and VICE are compared semantically (screen, on-screen text, counters, course times, sprite positions under input) by inspection, not by hash; counters and course times must be equal
